trigonometry-dash.title: Trigonometry Dash: Geometry Adventure Game
trigonometry-dash.slogan: Conquer Complex Geometric Maps with Trigonometry Dash
trigonometry-dash.description: Trigonometry Dash offers a unique platformer experience where you navigate through geometric challenges. With four game modes and customizable pace, enjoy a thrilling adventure. Play Trigonometry Dash now and explore the geometric world!

HomeIframe.title: Trigonometry Dash
HomeIframe.description: Trigonometry Dash invites you to experience a unique geometric adventure. Navigate through complex maps, avoid obstacles, and reach the finish line. Play now and enjoy the challenge!

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Trigonometry Dash is a platformer game that combines geometry and adventure. With unique gameplay and diverse modes, it offers a challenging yet enjoyable experience.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Use arrow keys to navigate the cube.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Avoid obstacles and find the path to the finish line.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Enjoy the game at your own pace and explore the geometric world.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Control the pace of the game and enjoy the adventure your way.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Choose from normal, time attack, monster, and blind modes.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Restart from the last checkpoint instead of starting over.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Experience a unique challenge with special portals in mirror mode.
